newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia police seize 290 kg of marijuana.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia police seize 290 kg of marijuana.

text.p: Malaysian police have seized more than 290 kg (640 pounds) of marijuana smuggled from outside the country in two separate incidents, the national Bernama news agency said on Tuesday.
In the first incident at a beach in northern Penang state, police uncovered 100 kg of the drugs stuffed into large bags and hidden in a boat, which was registered in a foreign country.
Bernama quoted Georgetown district police chief Koraiza Abdullah as saying police detained a young man, believed to be a foreigner.
In northern Perlis state, local police chief Loo Choo Huat said marine poice seized 190 kg of marijuana from a boat on Sunday.
He said the drugs were smuggled from a neighbouring country. Bernama did not name the neighbouring state but Malaysia's northern border is shared with Thailand.
Two men were detained in the Perlis incident.
